locations.name: Flooded Sublevel
locations.atmosphere: Dust hangs motionless in the air, refusing to settle, as if time here has stopped.
hazards: residual temporal discharge (sanity drains near the walls)

dialogue: "You shouldn't have come back here. It remembers you now."
"I counted the screams last night. There were more than there are of us."
"Day 52. The lights went out at 3:04 and never came back properly."
"It wears faces. If you see someone you lost — run."
alienBehavior: K'Thaal update: moves slower in the cold zones but sees farther.
storyBranch: The entity leaves a gift outside the safe room: a photograph of you, taken from behind, tonight.
